content.text: A local step of the Webdev runtime operation failed, so the operation did not complete. The step that failed is "install_dependencies". The project attempt is still held, so invoke the same registered Webdev tool again to resume from that step. Retry only once. If that retry fails, report the failure to the user. Until a Webdev operation returns success the resource is not ready and no preview exists: do not report the project as complete or opened, and do not treat your own check of a local port as evidence that it is.
